text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Hokko Tarumae invited me to
a board game cafe.
After meeting up with the two others and entering the shop—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There are many German-made games, too.
I hope there's something that can serve as inspiration
for your game, Tarumae-san...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's play lots and lots to get all those ideas bubbling up, Tarumae-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much...!
I'll study it thoroughly and put it to good use in my game development!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be helping create a card game
set in Tomakomai!
It's still in development, though...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This game is so cute~!
There are tiny cows and sheep too☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"The animal pieces are so cute!
They're so colorful, it makes my heart flutter...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Even in a place like this, they've got the customers' hearts totally captivated! Hehe, gaming might be just like being an Umadol☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see...!! Design really is important!
Something cute and pop might be nice...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I found a game I'd love to recommend, would the two of you care to play together?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That was super interesting~~!
My heart was pounding the whole time towards the end~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The tension was incredible...!
The winner wasn't decided until the very end, with chances for a turnaround remaining...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, how did they make this game
so thrilling and suspenseful...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As expected, this
Comeback Card must be the key.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Victory or defeat can be overturned depending on luck and the situation,
so we can't let our guard down until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Indeed...! It really makes you wonder who's holding a trump card for a massive comeback, and when they'll use it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Mind games, elements of luck... got it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, talking with everyone
and trading all kinds of cards was so much fun too~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Indeed, the resource negotiations were quite thrilling! The mind games with other players are truly part of this game's charm."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Negotiations and tactics!! I see...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much!
Your advice was incredibly helpful...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Make an awesome game, Tarumae-chan!
And let Falco play it when it's done!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"If there is anything you don't understand,
please feel free to consult me at any time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Hokko Tarumae wanted to review today's events right away,
so I came with her
to a family restaurant."
choice_data_list: Are your game ideas coming together?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Hearing the advice from both of you
has made the direction of the game much clearer!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Seems like there's room to tweak the rules...
So people can enjoy the thrill, like today's game,
and the psychological mind games—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: In that case, having an element of communication is definitely essential. Plus, adding a bit of luck creates broader strategic depth, so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae began pondering game ideas.
Not wanting to disturb her, I decided to
watch over her in silence.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
With this, the game is all set up!
It's still a prototype, but you can definitely play it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, we got to play the prototype game.
Pop and colorful cards featuring "Tomachop"
were laid out neatly across the desk.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! We went through many revisions
to ensure it would be an approachable design.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Let's begin then! I'll go first—flip one card from the deck and follow its instructions!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "‘You can look at any number of cards in your opponent's hand. However, if any of those cards is a Trap Card, you immediately lose the game.’ Right?"
choice_data_list: Psychological warfare right off the bat...!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! I came up with rules that let us enjoy some thrilling tactical mind games!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
While getting advice from Flash-san, I tried to pursue the mind-game aspect of it, but...
is there a problem...?
choice_data_list: No, let's just give it a try and play...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do that! Please give me your feedback later!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well then, um... Trainer,
do you have a Trap Card in your hand?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah! You just looked away from me! That seems kinda suspicious...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, we enjoyed an unusually tense psychological battle that completely belied the game's cute appearance...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The contrast, I see, that makes sense...!
I hadn't really been mindful of that...
choice_data_list: Looks like it'll be a hit with the hardcore crowd.
Looks like it'll be a hit with the hardcore crowd, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Really! I hope this helps raise
awareness for Tomakomai, even just a little...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later on, the gap between its cute appearance and serious rules became a hot topic among board game fans!
